get_target_dimensions: calculate target height and width for an image while preserving its aspect ratio within max patch constraints
aspect_ratio_preserving_resize: resize a numpy array image to fit within max patches while preserving its original aspect ratio
preprocess_image: preprocess a single image by converting to RGB, resizing, and normalizing pixel values to zero to one
predict_soft_token_count: predict the number of soft tokens an image will produce given its height and width dimensions
preprocess_and_patchify: preprocess a batch of images and patchify them with padding for the Gemma4 vision encoder
